title: Derived internal Hom from the structure sheaf is the identity
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and assume its unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ exists [def-pc-derived-category]. There is a natural isomorphism $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal O_Y[0],-)\simeq\mathrm{Id}_{D(\mathcal O_Y)}$, for the shared derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

source.place: Section 08J7: derived internal Hom; specialization to O_Y[0] and evaluation at one

proof.text: Evaluate an O_Y-linear map out of O_Y at one on every open. The inverse sends x to (r -> r*x); linearity and restriction compatibility give a natural sheaf isomorphism.
For Hom^bullet(O_Y[0], I), all product factors except p=0 are zero; evaluation identifies its differential with the differential of I.
Apply derivedInternalHom_comparison to the functorial K-injective resolution and compose evaluation with the inverse of the localized resolution map.
Descend the natural isomorphism through Q using fully faithful precomposition with a localization functor.
